ctx.x: So we got to the Deuces and worked around, and it was kind of hard times then. It just shows you, man. I won and Down Beat Award and couldn't get arrested. I had a ring, a diamond ring, and I pawned it. I must have pawned it to get the band out of town twenty times.
Oh, while I was there ...[AIRPLANE OVERHEAD] Barron(?) comes to see me...
That's while you were still in Chicago?
